legacy_methodology.legacy_known_survivor_bias: legacy pipeline intersects player IDs observed in both seasons

phase2_handoff: Cross-validate next-season availability by held-out base season. Compare position median only, deployed R2 blend, prior-year availability, 2-year mean, 2-year recency, 3-year mean, 3-year recency, and simple position-specific OLS variants. Keep survivor-only and unconditional targets separate so role/league-exit risk is not silently conflated with within-career injury persistence.

scope.unconditional_definition: base-season >=1 GP; next-season missing => zero availability
